article.detail:
Suno於10月28日發布MCP beta，讓用戶從Claude、ChatGPT等相容助手內構思及生成音樂，現階段需登記早期存取。

可由文字、錄音或循環片段開始，亦可處理資料庫歌曲的延伸與混搭。

生成歌曲存入Suno音樂庫，使用原有方案點數；公告涵蓋全部Suno方案。

先登記測試，以非客戶素材檢查點數、輸出及商業使用條款。

全部方案適用不等於所有帳戶已獲beta；連接器不代表開發者API全面開放或商用權利已核准。
article.detail_en:
Suno’s October 28 MCP beta connects music creation to compatible assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, with early-access registration.

Users can start with text, recordings or loops, or extend and remix library tracks.

Songs enter the Suno library and consume plan credits; the announcement covers all Suno plans.

Creative teams can bring soundtrack drafts into existing conversations while managing rights and spend.

Register for testing and check credits, exports and commercial terms with non-client material.

Plan eligibility does not mean every account has beta access; the connector establishes neither general API access nor cleared commercial rights.
